title: collection_state
description: A change-detector, not a read cursor. Whole-session invariant: on change, the collector re-parses the whole file and calls replace_session — never a partial/append read.

file_path.description: PK; the source file (or state.vscdb path)

last_size.description: file size (bytes) at last collect — CHANGE DETECTOR only, never a read boundary

last_hash.description: content hash — Cursor: sha256 over (composerId → fullConversationHeadersOnly) for workspace ItemTable composers and/or the global cursorDiskKV composerData store (plus a compact legacy aichat tab summary for workspace DBs); JSONL: optional tie-breaker
